The case status history is not a table of rwb_case. The state-change and creation items are read from the decision records of the case through the decision-record query of P7. The from queue and from owner of a transfer item come from the closed previous assignment row of the same case, and the rule version of a transfer item comes from its decision record. The decision-record query path, filter and field list are published in C RWB-P7-E1027-CON.

Open decisions apply to this baseline and stay open. DL10 (assumptions ASM-2250, ASM-2357, ASM-2377 and ASM-2863) and DL26 (assumptions ASM-0247, ASM-0264, ASM-0275 and ASM-0355) are open; the baseline applies each assumption as stated and decides neither.
